name: DarkVeil-TS-TW
title: Dark Veil
blurb: Organic, flowing dark texture with scanline effect and hue shifts.
description: WebGL shader using CPPN (Compositional Pattern Producing Network) to generate organic flowing textures. Includes hue shift, noise, scanline, and warp effects. Renders to canvas with continuous RAF animation.
use_when: Dark-themed backgrounds where an organic, almost living texture adds depth without demanding attention.
avoid_when: Light themes or when a clean background is required; this creates visual noise intentionally.
a11y: WebGL canvas with no semantic content. No keyboard interaction. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
